text:
alicia: Quick sync  saved-view UX for console analytics. We're still fielding confusion where a saved view doesn't lock model/routing, leading customers to think their dashboard will always use the same model. Need a clean design + API contract.

ben: Short summary: savedviews today persist filters + query context only. Customers expect "pinning" to persist which it does not. We should be explicit in UI and API.

mayra: UX idea: in the save modal show three toggles: [x] Persist filters/query, [ ] Pin model for this route, [ ] Include cost/quota preview. Default off for pin. If pin toggled, force selection of single route (otherwise show: "disable pinning for multi-route saves").

alicia: Good. For the list we should surface small chips: route=name, pinned=redwood/ao-13b (if set), variant=q4_0, est=$1.20/day. Chips are clickable to open a route-preview flyout. That gives immediate clarity without opening the full savedview.

sunil: API side: propose new savedview shape additions: route_id (nullable), pinned_model (nullable), model_variant (nullable), routing_policy (nullable), quota_snapshot_id (nullable), canary_pct (int, default 0). We'll expose a preview endpoint at /v2/routes/:id/savedview-preview which returns effective_model and cost_estimate.

ben: Naming nit: prefer snake_case? Our APIs are mixed. Let's align with existing routing-api style (we use camelCase in core public APIs). Use camelCase to be consistent.

mayra: UX flow question: what happens when a pinned model becomes unavailable? Show inline fallback policy: "Fallbacks: redwood/ao-7b -> redwood/ao-7b-quantized" and an action link "Edit fallback". Also surface reason in errors: "Pinned model currently unavailable in region EU-WEST-1; using fallback".

alicia: Agree. Add a small warning icon in list if any savedview has a fallback in effect. Hover tooltip explains actual model used.

ops-bot: routing-api/v2 deployed to staging 2025-02-12T08:00:00Z (canary 10% of hosts)

sunil: Telemetry: tag requests with savedViewId and savedViewPin (if present). We'll add a lightweight metric: saved_view_pin_hit_rate and a log event when fallback used along with route_id + deployment_scope. Sampling: 5% general, 100% for admin queries when using preview endpoint.

ben: Migration: For existing savedviews we can attempt a best-effort backfill: if the savedview was created from route context (console route page) attach route_id; else leave route_id null. Migration task should be idempotent and produce a migration report listing unmapped views.

mayra: Accessibility: make sure chips have descriptive aria-labels like "Saved view bound to route payments-service, pinned model redwood/ao-13b, variant q4_0".

alicia: One more product ask: allow save-as-canary (canary_pct) to route a fraction of users to the pinned model for testing. UI should let admins pick percentage increments (1,5,10,25,50). Routing will honor canaryPct if >0.

sunil: Backend will accept canaryPct and evaluate in smart-router. We'll add audit events whenever canaryPct changed. Also ensure canary doesn't bypass quota checks.

ben: Security question: savedviews can be shared org-wide. Pinned model names may leak model access. Add RBAC: only org roles with model-pin permission can pin models in a shared savedview. Otherwise hide the pin toggle.

mayra: UX mock tasks: 1) save modal with toggles + quota preview stub, 2) savedview list row with chips + warning state, 3) route-preview flyout showing effective_model, cost_daily, fallback list. I'll iterate and post Figma link.

alicia: Action owners: Ben -> openAPI diff and sample preview payload; Sunil -> telemetry + routing-api changes and migration plan; Mayra -> mocks and ARIA labels. Ops-bot scheduled deploy noted. Please report blockers by EOD PST. :thumbsup:
